description: Analyze a reference video and reverse-engineer its style into a reusable Seedance 2.0 prompting template for the Novoads API. The output is a new formula file — like seedance-2-ugc.md — that captures the video's structure, pacing, camera work, edit style and tone so it can be recreated with any product, any person, in any setting. Use this whenever someone provides a video they want to use as a style reference, says "I want to make videos like this", "deconstruct this video", "turn this into a template", "analyze this style", or drops a video file and wants to recreate that format repeatedly.
